scope: Read-only stopped-r3 proof diagnosis, source correction and proposed remaining validation review. No builds/tests/native runs or production edits. Owner approval required for any post-failure GPU validation.
disposition: No blocking source correctness issue identified. Recommend owner consider bounded remaining validation with one targeted cursorless-to-pointer transition inside affected F-DOA case; review is not approval.
diagnosis: Archived aggregate stopped at unsupported native board.json import after logging sample/damage/resource/styles successes. Aggregate test itself reports failure; only individually logged unchanged subcase results are reusable. Zero-test invocations supply no GPU evidence.

Correctly supplied F-DOA run passed cold and first pad-hover strong invalidation, then failed stable-pad-hover reuse assertion false versus true. This establishes failed reuse, not a pixel mismatch; failed stable case did not complete exact oracle comparison.

Board painter previously falls back scene_viewport when cursor-selected interaction_viewport is absent. Pixels::capture previously returned None in the same case, disabling reuse despite known painted hover geometry. Shared painted_interaction_viewport preserves existing board fallback and schematic no-cursor suppression.

Same-revision exposure now bypasses old/new geometry-support lookup only after matching completed key and physical pair. It resolves unchanged B; no restoration support is needed. Changed revisions still require both supports and bounded union, so unknown changes remain full reconstruction.
validation_recommendation: Require explicit owner approval of post-failure bounded scope before GPU work; preserve original logs and failed aggregate/zero-test/failed reuse dispositions. No silent continuation or reset.

Run affected F-DOA case once on pinned corrected source/binary and real original fixture hash, then previously unexecuted terminal, Console and old negative cases once; stop first mismatch/invalidity. Reuse unchanged sample primitive, damage/fault/resource and pointer-style results at original source scope.

Include within affected F-DOA case one cursorless completed board-hover -> pointer movement with unchanged effective hover transition, checking reuse and exact full-reference output. Stable same-revision exposure alone now bypasses support lookup and cannot independently validate corrected partial restoration bounds.
Retain CPU real cursorless geometry/clipping and same-revision unknown-support controls; no new broad audit or parameter sweep.
No performance trial until complete timer/attribution gate; this correction and recommendation do not qualify device duty, S4 or performance.
limitations: CPU controls source-inspected only; reviewer did not execute them.
Existing shared full-reference painter validates graph equivalence, not independent source-preparation truth.
Review does not retrospectively authorize fixture continuation; it describes preserved evidence and the now-proposed owner boundary.
